schema.description: Curated dictionary of *momentary* context-feature IRIs for persona-based simulation. Stable user characteristics (full Big Five score, identity, etc.) belong in persona `characteristics:`, NOT here. Trait STATES (e.g. currently behaving in a high-extraversion manner) are included under `trait_state`. behaviour_state and capability_opportunity entries carry theory_mappings tying the IRI to TDF / COM-B / HAPA / TTM / SDT.

emotion_process.label: emotion process
emotion_process.definition: An <affective process> that is a synchronized aggregate of constituent mental processes, including an appraisal process, which is valenced, has an object, and gives rise to an action tendency.

subjective_affective_feeling.label: subjective affective feeling
subjective_affective_feeling.definition: An <affective process> that involves the experience of internal or external sensory stimuli.

anger.label: anger
anger.definition: A negative emotion, characterised by feelings of unpleasantness and high arousal, in the form of antagonistic feelings and action tendencies.

disgust.label: disgust
disgust.definition: A negative emotion that is characterised by a need to get rid of, or distance oneself from, a stimulus that is appraised as repulsing.

fear.label: fear
fear.definition: A negative emotion that is aversive and characterised by feelings of threat and impending doom, and by an urge to get out of the situation.

anxiety.label: anxiety
anxiety.definition: A negative emotion that is aversive and provoked by the prospect of distal threat.

surprise.label: surprise
surprise.definition: An emotion caused by encountering unexpected events.

pleasure_emotion.label: pleasure (emotion)
pleasure_emotion.definition: A positive emotion which is sought out and is associated with happiness and satisfaction.

happiness.label: happiness
happiness.definition: A positive emotion which is experienced in reaction to a positive experience or event.

guilt.label: guilt
guilt.definition: A negative self-evaluative emotion that occurs when a person brings about a negative outcome by acts of commission or omission that violate internal or external moral standards.

shame.label: shame
shame.definition: A negative emotion that is distressing and occurs when one appraises one's behaviour or circumstance as wrong, dishonourable, immodest or indecorous.

sadness.label: sadness
sadness.definition: A negative emotion felt when an event is appraised as unpleasant and resulting in loss or failure.

feeling_at_ease.label: feeling at ease
feeling_at_ease.definition: A <subjective affective feeling> of being at ease, comfortable, relaxed.

feeling_nervous.label: feeling nervous
feeling_nervous.definition: A <subjective affective feeling> of being not at ease or agitated.

satisfaction.label: satisfaction
satisfaction.definition: An emotion that is experienced when one's wishes, expectations or needs are fulfilled.

depressed_mood.label: depressed mood
depressed_mood.definition: A <mood process> that involves generally feeling sad or blunted and experiencing low motivation to engage with activities.

emotion_about_self.label: emotion about self
emotion_about_self.definition: An <emotion process> that is about oneself.

emotional_behaviour.label: emotional behaviour
emotional_behaviour.definition: An experience-related behaviour that is caused by an emotion process.

anxiety_about_use_of_technology.label: anxiety about use of technology
anxiety_about_use_of_technology.definition: <Anxiety> about the prospect of using a product of technology.

anxiety_2.label: anxiety
anxiety_2.definition: Apprehension of danger and dread accompanied by restlessness, tension, tachycardia, and dyspnea unattached to a clearly identifiable stimulus.

feeling_tired.label: feeling tired
feeling_tired.definition: A <subjective affective feeling> of tiredness, needing sleep.

feeling_energetic.label: feeling energetic
feeling_energetic.definition: A <subjective affective feeling> of having lots of energy, being energetic.

feeling_exhausted.label: feeling exhausted
feeling_exhausted.definition: <Feeling tired> to an extremely strong degree.

feeling_weak.label: feeling weak
feeling_weak.definition: A subjective affective feeling of weakness, lack of energy and/or capability, faintness, absence of strength.

high_emotional_management_exertion_expen.label: high emotional management exertion expended on a behaviour
high_emotional_management_exertion_expen.definition: Emotional management exertion expended on a behaviour that is high.

low_emotional_management_exertion_expend.label: low emotional management exertion expended on a behaviour
low_emotional_management_exertion_expend.definition: Emotional management exertion expended on a behaviour that is low.

moderate_emotional_management_exertion_e.label: moderate emotional management exertion expended on a behaviour
moderate_emotional_management_exertion_e.definition: Emotional management exertion expended on a behaviour that is medium.

feeling_of_pain.label: feeling of pain
feeling_of_pain.definition: A <subjective affective feeling> in an organism S, involving two integrated levels: (a) activation of the nociceptive system and associated emotion generating brain components of S, and (b) a simultaneous aversive sensory and emotional experience on the part of S, where (b) is phenomenologically similar to the sort of aversive experience involved in pain with concordant tissue damage.

feeling_of_hunger.label: feeling of hunger
feeling_of_hunger.definition: A <subjective affective feeling> that involves discomfort and is associated with a need to consume food.

feeling_bad.label: feeling bad
feeling_bad.definition: A subjective affective feeling that is negatively valenced.

pain_feeling.label: pain feeling
pain_feeling.definition: A subjective affective feeling that is an unpleasant sensory and emotional experience associated with

feeling_ill.label: feeling ill
feeling_ill.definition: A subjective affective feeling associated with physical unwellness

injury_feeling.label: injury feeling
injury_feeling.definition: A subjective affective feeling that results from physical damage to one's body.

self_efficacy_belief_for_a_behaviour_und.label: self-efficacy belief for a behaviour under conditions of stress
self_efficacy_belief_for_a_behaviour_und.definition: A <situational self-efficacy belief for a behaviour> that is enacted when under stress.

distress_minimisation_behaviour.label: distress minimisation behaviour
distress_minimisation_behaviour.definition: An experience-related behaviour that involves avoiding, reducing or escaping anxiety, stress, sorrow, shame and unhappiness.

fear_reducing_process.label: fear reducing process
fear_reducing_process.definition: A <bodily process> that reduces fear without necessarily reducing the threat.

anxiety.label: anxiety
anxiety.definition: Apprehension of danger and dread accompanied by restlessness, tension, tachycardia, and dyspnea unattached to a clearly identifiable stimulus.

anxiety_disorder.label: anxiety disorder
anxiety_disorder.definition: A category of psychiatric disorders which are characterized by anxious feelings or fear often accompanied by physical symptoms associated with anxiety.

office.label: office
office.definition: A building part within which administrative work is done by an organisations users in order to support and realise the objectives of that organization.

office_building.label: office building
office_building.definition: A commercial building which contains parts used as workplaces primarily for administrative and managerial workers.

restaurant.label: restaurant
restaurant.definition: A building within which food and drink are prepared and served to customers in exchange for money or other goods and/or services.

cafeteria.label: cafeteria
cafeteria.definition: A building which provides the site for food services with little or no waiting staff furnishing table service.

take_out_restaurant.label: take-out restaurant
take_out_restaurant.definition: A restaurant which provides prepared meals or other food products that the purchaser must eat off its premises.

grocery_store.label: grocery store
grocery_store.definition: A food shop in which food products are the primary offer for sale or trade.

supermarket.label: supermarket
supermarket.definition: A self-service shop offering a wide variety of food, beverages and household products, organized into sections.

human_dwelling.label: human dwelling
human_dwelling.definition: A self-contained constructed feature used by one or more households as a home, such as a house, apartment, mobile home, houseboat or other 'substantial' structure. A dwelling typically includes nearby outbuildings, sheds etc. within the curtilage of the property, excluding any 'open fields beyond'. It has significance in relation to search and seizure, conveyancing of real property, burglary, trespass, and land use planning.

household_environment.label: household environment
household_environment.definition: An anthropogenic environment which is bounded by a human dwelling.

indoor_kitchen.label: indoor kitchen
indoor_kitchen.definition: An indoor kitchen is a room or part of a room primarily used  for cooking or food preparation, but which may have other funcitons such as dining, food storage, dishwashing, or laundry.

bathroom.label: bathroom
bathroom.definition: A bathroom is a room which contains a washbasin or other fixture, such as a shower or bath, used for bathing by humans.

living_room.label: living room
living_room.definition: A living room is a room in a human house which is used for social and domestic leisure activities.

room.label: room
room.definition: A building part which is separated from other building parts by one or more interior walls and, optionally, outdoor areas by one or more exterior walls.

school_building.label: school building
school_building.definition: An institutional building in which students are educated.

university_building.label: university building
university_building.definition: An institutional building in which university services are performed.

university_campus.label: university campus
university_campus.definition: An area of land on which a college or university and related institutional buildings are situated.

sports_facility.label: sports facility
sports_facility.definition: A building or region where sports activities can be carried out.

winter_sports_facility.label: winter sports facility
winter_sports_facility.definition: A sports facility constructed for skiing and allied sports that require snow and/or ice.

public_sports_field.label: public sports field
public_sports_field.definition: A sports facility which has been constructed for sports that require large outdoor spaces and is owned by a governmental or state entity and which is accessible by its citizenry (i.e. the public).

playground.label: playground
playground.definition: A park which has been designed for the recreation of children.

public_park.label: public park
public_park.definition: A park which is owned by a governmental or state entity and which is accessible by its citizenry (i.e. the public).

garden.label: garden
garden.definition: An enclosure for displaying selected plant or animal life.

domestic_garden.label: domestic garden
domestic_garden.definition: A garden that is associated with a human house. This association is generally one of spatial proximity or parthood.

botanical_garden.label: botanical garden
botanical_garden.definition: A place where a wide variety of plants primarily categorized and documented for scientific purposes.

outdoor_environment.label: outdoor environment
outdoor_environment.definition: An environmental system which is not sheltered.

sidewalk.label: sidewalk
sidewalk.definition: A constructed pavement which is built on the side of a road and intended for foot traffic.

transport_hub.label: transport hub
transport_hub.definition: A place where passengers and cargo are exchanged between vehicles or/and between transport modes.

public_transit_system.label: public transit system
public_transit_system.definition: A constructed transport system which is owned by a government or other form of public representation.

public_bus.label: public bus
public_bus.definition: A bus which is part of public infrastructure.

rapid_transit_system.label: rapid transit system
rapid_transit_system.definition: A public transit system which is owned by a government or other form of public representation.

car.label: car
car.definition: A car is a wheeled motor vehicle used primarily for the transportation of human passengers. Most definitions of the term specify that cars are designed to run primarily on roads, to have seating for one to eight people, to typically have four wheels, and to be constructed principally for the transport of people rather than goods.

bus.label: bus
bus.definition: A bus is a road vehicle designed to carry many passengers.

healthcare_facility.label: healthcare facility
healthcare_facility.definition: A human construction in which healthcare is provided.

day_care_facility.label: day care facility
day_care_facility.definition: A child care facility in which day care services are provided, by specialized staff and equipment, to a human child during the working day.

nursing_home.label: nursing home
nursing_home.definition: A building in which nursing aides and skilled nurses provide care and treatment to residents who have significant difficulty coping with the required activities of daily living.

homeless_shelter.label: homeless shelter
homeless_shelter.definition: An institutional building which temporarily houses homeless people.

community_health_centre.label: community health centre
community_health_centre.definition: A healthcare facility which is used by a group of general practitioners and nurses to provide healthcare services to people in a certain area.

community_service_centre.label: community service centre
community_service_centre.definition: A public building in which health, recreation or other public services to a local community are provided.

physician_office.label: physician office
physician_office.definition: A healthcare facility which is the office of a physician.

group_home_facility.label: group home facility
group_home_facility.definition: A long-term care facility which is used to provide care for people with complex health needs, and which typically has at least one caregiver in attendance twenty four hours a day.

long_term_care_facility.label: long-term care facility
long_term_care_facility.definition: A residential building which is used to provides long-term care for residents.

business_park.label: business park
business_park.definition: An area of developed space which is reserved for office buildings.

industrial_park.label: industrial park
industrial_park.definition: A human construction which is used for the purpose of industrial development.

outdoorbuildingspace.label: outdoor building space
outdoorbuildingspace.definition: A SAREF building space representing an outdoor area of a building (COPPER NamedIndividual of saref4bldg:BuildingSpace).

indoorbuildingspace.label: indoor building space
indoorbuildingspace.definition: A SAREF building space representing an indoor area of a building (COPPER NamedIndividual of saref4bldg:BuildingSpace).

home.label: home
home.definition: A domestic Building where one lives permanently, as a member of a family or household

home_2.label: home instance
home_2.definition: A particular home instance (COPPER NamedIndividual typed as COPPER:Home, a domestic building where one lives permanently).

workplace.label: workplace
workplace.definition: A particular workplace instance (COPPER NamedIndividual typed as OMRSE workplace facility, where one is employed).

in_a_park.label: in a park
in_a_park.definition: A particular park-visit context (COPPER NamedIndividual typed as ENVO_01001199 park).

workplace_2.label: workplace facility
workplace_2.definition: A facility, such as an office, factory or shop, where people are employed (OMRSE, Medically Related Social Entities).

social_context.label: social context
social_context.definition: A physical activity plan context characteristic that describes the company needed to execute the activity

access_to_required_activity_companion.label: access to required activity companion
access_to_required_activity_companion.definition: Access to people that are required for a given activity

activity_companion_cancellation.label: activity companion cancellation
activity_companion_cancellation.definition: A social influence behavior concerning the reliability of other social agents that are required to perform a given activity

access_to_desired_activity_companion.label: access to desired activity companion
access_to_desired_activity_companion.definition: Access to people that are appreciated as company for a given activity

social_environmental_system.label: social environmental system
social_environmental_system.definition: An <environmental system> that consists of people, their pets, social and cultural institutions and processes that influence the life of people and social groups.

family_environmental_system.label: family environmental system
family_environmental_system.definition: A <social environmental system> that consists of persons related as members of a domestic group, or a number of domestic groups linked through descent from a common ancestor, marriage,  adoption or other legal arrangements.

friendship_network.label: friendship network
friendship_network.definition: A <social environmental system> that consists of persons who share a bond of mutual affection and are in contact or communication.

social_behavioural_opportunity.label: social behavioural opportunity
social_behavioural_opportunity.definition: A <behavioural opportunity> that involves the social environmental system.

belief_about_social_support.label: belief about social support
belief_about_social_support.definition: A <belief about one's social environment> in terms of whether others will provide or are available to provide assistance or comfort to help the person cope with one or more stressors or enhance their wellbeing.

social_alienation.label: social alienation
social_alienation.definition: A <mental disposition> to perceive or experience oneself as isolated from and not meaningfully involved in social groups.

weather_opportunity.label: weather opportunity
weather_opportunity.definition: A physical behaviour opportunity that is appropriate weatherconditions for an activity.

sufficiently_warm_temperate.label: sufficiently warm temperate
sufficiently_warm_temperate.definition: An appropriate temperature that is warm enough for an activity.

appropriate_amount_of_wind.label: appropriate amount of wind
appropriate_amount_of_wind.definition: A weather opportunity that is the presence of a suitable amount of wind for an activity.

sufficient_lack_of_wind.label: sufficient lack of wind
sufficient_lack_of_wind.definition: An appropriate amount of wind that is not too much for an activity.

sufficient_wind.label: sufficient wind
sufficient_wind.definition: An appropriate amount of wind that is not too little for an activity.

it_is_too_cold.label: it is too cold
it_is_too_cold.definition: A weather state in which the temperature is below the warm-temperate range needed for outdoor activity (COPPER NamedIndividual).

it_is_too_warm.label: it is too warm
it_is_too_warm.definition: A weather state in which the temperature is above the warm-temperate range needed for outdoor activity (COPPER NamedIndividual).

it_is_raining_snowing.label: it is raining / snowing
it_is_raining_snowing.definition: A weather state of active precipitation (rain or snow) that interferes with planned outdoor activity (COPPER NamedIndividual).

there_is_too_much_wind.label: there is too much wind
there_is_too_much_wind.definition: A weather state in which wind speed exceeds the appropriate range for outdoor activity (COPPER NamedIndividual).

weather_preference.label: weather preference
weather_preference.definition: A physical performance behaviour preference concerning carrying out outdoor activities under different weather circumstances.

behavioural_intention.label: behavioural intention
behavioural_intention.definition: A <mental disposition> to commit to enact or not enact a behaviour.

behavioural_motivation.label: behavioural motivation
behavioural_motivation.definition: A <mental process> that energises and directs a behaviour.

automatic_behavioural_motivation.label: automatic behavioural motivation
automatic_behavioural_motivation.definition: <Behavioural motivation> that arises from emotions and impulses that result from associative learning or innate dispositions.

intrinsic_motivation.label: intrinsic motivation
intrinsic_motivation.definition: <Autonomous motivation> due to a behaviour's inherent enjoyment, satisfaction or benefits to oneself.

autonomous_motivation.label: autonomous motivation
autonomous_motivation.definition: <Behavioural motivation> that is internally generated and based on a behaviour being interesting or valuable to an individual.

self_efficacy_belief_for_a_behaviour.label: self-efficacy belief for a behaviour
self_efficacy_belief_for_a_behaviour.definition: A <self-efficacy belief> to organise and execute a behaviour.

self_regulation_of_behaviour.label: self-regulation of behaviour
self_regulation_of_behaviour.definition: A <self-regulation process> that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of one's  performance of a behaviour.

action_planning.label: action planning
action_planning.definition: <Planning> that has as a part some goal that is specified in terms of some behaviour and a time or place where the behaviour is to be enacted.

coping_planning.label: coping planning
coping_planning.definition: <Planning> that involves identifying and attempting to overcome barriers to enacting a behaviour.

habitual_behaviour.label: habitual behaviour
habitual_behaviour.definition: An <individual human behaviour> that results from a learnt stimulus-behaviour co-occurrence.

habit_learning.label: habit learning
habit_learning.definition: <Associative learning> that involves strengthening an association between a stimulus and an impulse through repetition of co-occurrence of the stimulus and the behaviour.

behaviour_pattern_maintenance.label: behaviour pattern maintenance
behaviour_pattern_maintenance.definition: An individual human behaviour pattern that is continued.

intention_not_to_enact_a_behaviour.label: intention not to enact a behaviour
intention_not_to_enact_a_behaviour.definition: A <behavioural intention> not to enact a behaviour.

intention_to_enact_a_behaviour.label: intention to enact a behaviour
intention_to_enact_a_behaviour.definition: A <behavioural intention> to enact a behaviour.

intention_for_collective_behaviour.label: intention for collective behaviour
intention_for_collective_behaviour.definition: A <behavioural intention> to enact a behaviour with one or more others.

subjective_craving.label: subjective craving
subjective_craving.definition: A <subjective affective feeling> involving a strong desire or urge.

self_efficacy_belief_for_a_behaviour_and.label: self-efficacy belief for a behaviour and its associated outcomes
self_efficacy_belief_for_a_behaviour_and.definition: HAPA 'action self-efficacy' — confidence in initiating the behaviour.

behaviour_maintenance_self_efficacy.label: behaviour maintenance self-efficacy
behaviour_maintenance_self_efficacy.definition: HAPA 'maintenance self-efficacy' — confidence in sustaining the behaviour over time.

behavioural_recovery_self_efficacy.label: behavioural recovery self-efficacy
behavioural_recovery_self_efficacy.definition: HAPA 'recovery self-efficacy' — confidence in restarting after a lapse.

acquired_drive.label: acquired drive
acquired_drive.definition: A <drive process> in which the physiological need is acquired through experience.

approval_based_motivation.label: approval-based motivation
approval_based_motivation.definition: A <need-based motivation> related to gaining or maintaining social approval or a positive self-evaluation.

behavioural_importance_based_motivation.label: behavioural importance-based motivation
behavioural_importance_based_motivation.definition: <Autonomous motivation> due to the perceived value or importance of the behaviour to oneself.

drive_process.label: drive process
drive_process.definition: A <behavioural motivation> that results from a physiological need.

extrinsic_motivation.label: extrinsic motivation
extrinsic_motivation.definition: <Behaviour motivation> that is based on external rewards, punishments or pressure regarding a behaviour.

extrinsic_social_motivation.label: extrinsic social motivation
extrinsic_social_motivation.definition: An <extrinsic motivation> that derives from external rewards, punishments or pressure regarding a behaviour.

innate_drive.label: innate drive
innate_drive.definition: A <drive process>in which the physiological need is determined prenatally.

motivation_to_avert_harm.label: motivation to avert harm
motivation_to_avert_harm.definition: <Motivation to reduce harm> that may occur in the future.

motivation_to_comply.label: motivation to comply
motivation_to_comply.definition: A <behavioural motivation> to act in accordance with the likely approval of others.

motivation_to_deviate.label: motivation to deviate
motivation_to_deviate.definition: A <behavioural motivation> to act contrary to likely approval of others.

motivation_to_reduce_current_harm.label: motivation to reduce current harm
motivation_to_reduce_current_harm.definition: <Motivation to reduce harm> that is ongoing.

need_based_motivation.label: need-based motivation
need_based_motivation.definition: <Autonomous motivation> due to a behaviour being perceived to satisfy a psychological need.

self_motive.label: self-motive
self_motive.definition: A <behavioural motivation> that arises from a person’s self-identity.

self_efficacy_belief_for_a_behaviour_dur.label: self-efficacy belief for a behaviour during routine activities
self_efficacy_belief_for_a_behaviour_dur.definition: A <self-efficacy belief for a behaviour> that is enacted as part of activities that are routine.

self_efficacy_belief_for_a_behaviour_in_.label: self-efficacy belief for a behaviour in the face of social pressure
self_efficacy_belief_for_a_behaviour_in_.definition: A <situational self-efficacy belief for a behaviour> that is enacted against social pressire.

situational_self_efficacy_belief_for_a_b.label: situational self-efficacy belief for a behaviour
situational_self_efficacy_belief_for_a_b.definition: A <self-efficacy belief for a behaviour> when a barrier or facilitator of the behaviour is encountered.

physical_behavioural_capability.label: physical behavioural capability
physical_behavioural_capability.definition: A <behavioural capability> that involves sensory or musculoskeletal abilities.

psychological_behavioural_capability.label: psychological behavioural capability
psychological_behavioural_capability.definition: A <behavioural capability> that involves psychological abilities.

physical_behavioural_opportunity.label: physical behavioural opportunity
physical_behavioural_opportunity.definition: A <behavioural opportunity> that involves time and parts of the environmental system that do not involve people or organisations.

social_behavioural_opportunity.label: social behavioural opportunity
social_behavioural_opportunity.definition: A <behavioural opportunity> that involves the social environmental system.

need_for_autonomy.label: need for autonomy
need_for_autonomy.definition: A <psychological need> to have a sense of personal agency and initiative.

need_to_feel_competent.label: need to feel competent
need_to_feel_competent.definition: A <psychological need> to experience oneself as capable and effective.

need_for_a_sense_of_belonging_and_attach.label: need for a sense of belonging and attachment
need_for_a_sense_of_belonging_and_attach.definition: A <psychological need> to have caring relationships with other people.

low_physical_opportunity_to_enact_a_beha.label: low physical opportunity to enact a behaviour
low_physical_opportunity_to_enact_a_beha.definition: <Low opportunity to enact a behaviour> where the opportunity is physical.

low_social_opportunity_to_enact_a_behavi.label: low social opportunity to enact a behaviour
low_social_opportunity_to_enact_a_behavi.definition: <Low opportunity to enact a behaviour> where the opportunity is social.

low_self_efficacy.label: low self-efficacy
low_self_efficacy.definition: An <personal attribute> of self-efficacy belief that is low.

assertiveness_skill.label: assertiveness skill
assertiveness_skill.definition: A <communication skill> that is realised as the person expressing their views, needs or feelings whilst respecting those of others with whom they are communicating.

communication_skill.label: communication skill
communication_skill.definition: A <social skill> that is realised as effective communication behaviour

control_over_behaviour.label: control over behaviour
control_over_behaviour.definition: A <behavioural capability> or <behavioural opportunity> that affords control over one's behaviour.

negotiating_skill.label: negotiating skill
negotiating_skill.definition: A <communication skill> whose aim is to reach an agreement with another person or people through discussion.

physical_skill.label: physical skill
physical_skill.definition: A <physical behavioural capability> acquired through training or practice.

social_behavioural_capability.label: social behavioural capability
social_behavioural_capability.definition: A <personal capability> includes interpersonal behaviour in its realisation.

social_skill.label: social skill
social_skill.definition: A <social behavioural capability> acquired through training or practice.

behavioural_opportunity_through_informat.label: behavioural opportunity through information
behavioural_opportunity_through_informat.definition: A <behavioural opportunity> that is realised by the provision of accurate information.

financial_behavioural_opportunity.label: financial behavioural opportunity
financial_behavioural_opportunity.definition: A <physical behavioural opportunity> that involves the person having sufficient financial resources.

healthcare_access.label: healthcare access
healthcare_access.definition: A <behavioural opportunity> regarding how easy it is for a person to approach and use a healthcare service.

leisure_time.label: leisure time
leisure_time.definition: A <temporal behavioural opportunity> for recreational activities.

physical_access_to_a_facility.label: physical access to a facility
physical_access_to_a_facility.definition: A <physical behavioural opportunity> that involves having access to a facility in which the behaviour can occur.

technology_availability.label: technology availability
technology_availability.definition: A <behavioural opportunity> that involves the extend to which technology is available in the environmental system.

temporal_behavioural_opportunity.label: temporal behavioural opportunity
temporal_behavioural_opportunity.definition: A <physical behavioural opportunity> that involves the person having sufficient time or a suitable period.

behavioural_intention.label: behavioural intention
behavioural_intention.definition: A <mental disposition> to commit to enact or not enact a behaviour.

intention_for_collective_behaviour.label: intention for collective behaviour
intention_for_collective_behaviour.definition: A <behavioural intention> to enact a behaviour with one or more others.

intention_to_enact_a_behaviour.label: intention to enact a behaviour
intention_to_enact_a_behaviour.definition: A <behavioural intention> to enact a behaviour.

intention_not_to_enact_a_behaviour.label: intention not to enact a behaviour
intention_not_to_enact_a_behaviour.definition: A <behavioural intention> not to enact a behaviour.

goal_interaction.label: goal interaction
goal_interaction.definition: An <information content entity> that is about the extent to which goals are compatible with each other.

belief_about_consequences_of_goal_attain.label: belief about consequences of goal attainment
belief_about_consequences_of_goal_attain.definition: A <belief about consequences of an occurrence> in terms of the outcomes resulting from achieving a goal.

disposition_to_attend_to_one_s_goals.label: disposition to attend to one’s goals
disposition_to_attend_to_one_s_goals.definition: An <attentional disposition> to attend to one's goals.

accepted_assigned_goal.label: accepted assigned goal
accepted_assigned_goal.definition: An assigned <goal> that the person has some level of commitment to.

active_goal.label: active goal
active_goal.definition: A <goal> that is being pursued at any one point in time.

assigned_goal.label: assigned goal
assigned_goal.definition: A <goal> that has been set by another person.

background_goal.label: background goal
background_goal.definition: A <goal> that is not currently being pursued.

behavioural_goal.label: behavioural goal
behavioural_goal.definition: A <goal> in which the end state is a behaviour or behavioural pattern.

collaborative_goal.label: collaborative goal
collaborative_goal.definition: A <goal> that is set collaboratively between the person for which the goal is set and at least one other person.

distal_goal.label: distal goal
distal_goal.definition: A <goal> that is about a scenario that is in the distant future.

goal_about_ones_resources.label: goal about one’s resources
goal_about_ones_resources.definition: A <goal> that concerns protecting or increasing the person’s resources.

hedonic_goal.label: hedonic goal
hedonic_goal.definition: A <proximal goal> in which the end state is pleasure or relief from displeasure.

learning_goal.label: learning goal
learning_goal.definition: A <goal> that focuses on the acquisition of new skills or knowledge.

normative_goal.label: normative goal
normative_goal.definition: A <goal> that is consistent with a prevailing group norm.

proximal_goal.label: proximal goal
proximal_goal.definition: A <goal> that is about a scenario in the near future.

self_initiated_goal.label: self-initiated goal
self_initiated_goal.definition: A <goal> that a person has set for themselves.

well_specified_goal.label: well-specified goal
well_specified_goal.definition: A <goal> that is specified in sufficient detail for it to be clear when the goal has been achieved.

extraverted_state.label: extraversion
extraverted_state.definition: A state in which attention is largely directed outward from the self.
extraverted_state.comment: User is currently behaving in a high-extraversion manner (talkative, sociable, energetic).

introverted_state.label: Extraversion, low state
introverted_state.definition: A state in which attention is largely directed inward, with reserved and solitary expression.
introverted_state.comment: User is currently in a low-extraversion state (reserved, solitary).

agreeable_state.label: Agreeableness, high state
agreeable_state.comment: User is currently behaving cooperatively, trustingly, warmly.
agreeable_state.definition: A momentary expression of high agreeableness: behaving cooperatively, trustingly, and warmly toward others (John & Srivastava 1999).

antagonistic_state.label: Agreeableness, low state
antagonistic_state.comment: User is currently behaving competitively, distrustfully, harshly.
antagonistic_state.definition: A momentary expression of low agreeableness: behaving competitively, distrustfully, or harshly toward others (John & Srivastava 1999).

conscientious_state.label: Conscientiousness, high state
conscientious_state.comment: User is currently in a focused, disciplined, organised state.
conscientious_state.definition: A momentary expression of high conscientiousness: behaving in a focused, disciplined, and organised manner (John & Srivastava 1999).

careless_state.label: Conscientiousness, low state
careless_state.comment: User is currently in a spontaneous, careless, disorganised state.
careless_state.definition: A momentary expression of low conscientiousness: behaving spontaneously, carelessly, or in a disorganised way (John & Srivastava 1999).

emotionally_reactive_state.label: Neuroticism, high state
emotionally_reactive_state.comment: User is currently emotionally reactive, anxious, irritable (high neuroticism).
emotionally_reactive_state.definition: A momentary expression of high neuroticism: emotional reactivity, anxiety, or irritability (John & Srivastava 1999).

emotionally_stable_state.label: Neuroticism, low state
emotionally_stable_state.comment: User is currently emotionally stable, calm, even-tempered (low neuroticism).
emotionally_stable_state.definition: A momentary expression of low neuroticism: emotional stability, calm, and even temperament (John & Srivastava 1999).

open_to_experience_state.label: Openness to experience, high state
open_to_experience_state.comment: User is currently curious, imaginative, open to new ideas.
open_to_experience_state.definition: A momentary expression of high openness: curiosity, imagination, and willingness to consider new ideas (John & Srivastava 1999).

conventional_state.label: Openness to experience, low state
conventional_state.comment: User is currently conventional, routine-seeking, closed to new ideas.
conventional_state.definition: A momentary expression of low openness: a preference for routine, convention, and the familiar (John & Srivastava 1999).

novelty_seeking_state.label: Novelty seeking, high state
novelty_seeking_state.comment: User is currently exploratory, impulsive, drawn to novelty (high NS).
novelty_seeking_state.definition: A momentary expression of high novelty seeking on the TCI: exploratory, impulsive, and drawn to novel stimuli (Cloninger, Svrakic & Przybeck 1993).

routine_oriented_state.label: Novelty seeking, low state
routine_oriented_state.comment: User is currently in a routine-bound, stoic state (low NS).
routine_oriented_state.definition: A momentary expression of low novelty seeking on the TCI: routine-bound, stoic, and reflective (Cloninger, Svrakic & Przybeck 1993).

harm_avoidant_state.label: Harm avoidance, high state
harm_avoidant_state.comment: User is currently cautious, pessimistic, fearful (high HA).
harm_avoidant_state.definition: A momentary expression of high harm avoidance on the TCI: cautious, anticipating risk, and fearful (Cloninger, Svrakic & Przybeck 1993).

risk_tolerant_state.label: Harm avoidance, low state
risk_tolerant_state.comment: User is currently confident, optimistic, energetic (low HA).
risk_tolerant_state.definition: A momentary expression of low harm avoidance on the TCI: confident, optimistic, and energetic in the face of risk (Cloninger, Svrakic & Przybeck 1993).

reward_dependent_state.label: Reward dependence, high state
reward_dependent_state.comment: User is currently sentimental, sociable, approval-seeking (high RD).
reward_dependent_state.definition: A momentary expression of high reward dependence on the TCI: sentimental, sociable, and responsive to social approval (Cloninger, Svrakic & Przybeck 1993).

reward_independent_state.label: Reward dependence, low state
reward_independent_state.comment: User is currently detached, independent of social approval (low RD).
reward_independent_state.definition: A momentary expression of low reward dependence on the TCI: detached and unaffected by social approval (Cloninger, Svrakic & Przybeck 1993).

persistent_state.label: Persistence, high state
persistent_state.comment: User is currently industrious, perfectionistic, determined (high P).
persistent_state.definition: A momentary expression of high persistence on the TCI: industrious, perfectionistic, and determined to continue despite frustration (Cloninger, Svrakic & Przybeck 1993).

easily_discouraged_state.label: Persistence, low state
easily_discouraged_state.comment: User is currently easily discouraged, gives up readily (low P).
easily_discouraged_state.definition: A momentary expression of low persistence on the TCI: easily discouraged and prone to give up under frustration (Cloninger, Svrakic & Przybeck 1993).

self_directed_state.label: Self-directedness, high state
self_directed_state.comment: User is currently goal-directed, resourceful, self-accepting (high SD).
self_directed_state.definition: A momentary expression of high self-directedness on the TCI: goal-directed, resourceful, and self-accepting (Cloninger, Svrakic & Przybeck 1993).

blaming_state.label: Self-directedness, low state
blaming_state.comment: User is currently blaming, undisciplined, lacking inner direction (low SD).
blaming_state.definition: A momentary expression of low self-directedness on the TCI: blaming others, undisciplined, and lacking inner direction (Cloninger, Svrakic & Przybeck 1993).

cooperative_state.label: Cooperativeness, high state
cooperative_state.comment: User is currently empathic, helpful, principled (high C).
cooperative_state.definition: A momentary expression of high cooperativeness on the TCI: empathic, helpful, and principled in dealings with others (Cloninger, Svrakic & Przybeck 1993).

uncooperative_state.label: Cooperativeness, low state
uncooperative_state.comment: User is currently hostile, opportunistic, revengeful (low C).
uncooperative_state.definition: A momentary expression of low cooperativeness on the TCI: hostile, opportunistic, and revengeful (Cloninger, Svrakic & Przybeck 1993).

self_transcendent_state.label: Self-transcendence, high state
self_transcendent_state.comment: User is currently spiritual, judicious, accepting of ambiguity (high ST).
self_transcendent_state.definition: A momentary expression of high self-transcendence on the TCI: spiritual, judicious, and accepting of ambiguity (Cloninger, Svrakic & Przybeck 1993).

individualistic_state.label: Self-transcendence, low state
individualistic_state.comment: User is currently materialistic, controlling, self-conscious (low ST).
individualistic_state.definition: A momentary expression of low self-transcendence on the TCI: materialistic, controlling, and self-conscious (Cloninger, Svrakic & Przybeck 1993).

impulsive_state.label: impulsivity
impulsive_state.definition: A momentary tendency to act on urges without forethought (Patton, Stanford & Barratt 1995, BIS-11).

sensation_seeking_state.label: sensation seeking
sensation_seeking_state.comment: User is currently in a sensation-seeking state.
sensation_seeking_state.definition: A momentary preference for varied, novel, complex, and intense sensations and experiences (Zuckerman 1994, SSS-V).

optimistic_state.label: optimism
optimistic_state.comment: User is currently in an optimistic frame of mind.
optimistic_state.definition: A momentary generalised expectation that good rather than bad outcomes will occur (Carver & Scheier 2014, LOT-R).

pessimistic_state.label: pessimism
pessimistic_state.comment: User is currently in a pessimistic frame of mind.
pessimistic_state.definition: A momentary generalised expectation that bad rather than good outcomes will occur (Carver & Scheier 2014, LOT-R).

consciousness_raising.label: self-awareness process in relation to a problem
consciousness_raising.definition: TTM 'consciousness raising' — increasing awareness about a problem behaviour.

dramatic_relief.label: dramatic relief (TTM process)
dramatic_relief.definition: TTM 'dramatic relief' — emotional arousal about the health behaviour.

environmental_reevaluation.label: social consequence of behaviour appraisal process
environmental_reevaluation.definition: TTM 'environmental re-evaluation' — realising how one's unhealthy behaviour affects others.

self_reevaluation.label: self-identity appraisal informed by one's behaviour
self_reevaluation.definition: TTM 'self re-evaluation' — appraising the healthy behaviour as part of who one wants to be.

social_liberation.label: social liberation (TTM process)
social_liberation.definition: TTM 'social liberation' — environmental opportunities that show society supports the healthy behaviour.

counter_conditioning.label: counter-conditioning (TTM process)
counter_conditioning.definition: TTM 'counter-conditioning' — substituting healthy behaviours for unhealthy ones.

helping_relationships.label: helping relationships (TTM process)
helping_relationships.definition: TTM 'helping relationships' — finding supportive relationships that reinforce the healthy behaviour.

self_liberation.label: self-liberation (TTM process)
self_liberation.definition: TTM 'self-liberation' — committing to behaviour change based on belief in one's own efficacy.

stimulus_control.label: stimulus control (TTM process)
stimulus_control.definition: TTM 'stimulus control' — re-engineering the environment to cue the desired behaviour.

decisional_balance.label: decisional balance process about changing behaviour
decisional_balance.definition: TTM 'decisional balance' — weighing the pros and cons of change.

action_planning_bct.label: action planning BCT
action_planning_bct.definition: Behaviour change technique: action planning — formulate a detailed plan of when, where, and how to perform the behaviour.

behavioural_substitution.label: behavioural substitution
behavioural_substitution.definition: BCT: substitute the target behaviour for an alternative.

prompt_intended_action.label: prompt intended action BCT
prompt_intended_action.definition: BCT: arrange an environmental cue that prompts the intended behaviour.

provide_distraction.label: provide distraction BCT
provide_distraction.definition: BCT: directly distract from an unwanted behaviour by offering another focus.

advise_distraction.label: advise distraction BCT
advise_distraction.definition: BCT: advise on shifting attention away from an unwanted behaviour.

reduce_distraction.label: reduce distraction BCT
reduce_distraction.definition: BCT: remove or attenuate environmental cues that compete with the target behaviour.

manage_automatic_responses.label: enable person to manage automatic responses BCT
manage_automatic_responses.definition: BCT: provide skills (e.g. mindfulness, breathing) for managing automatic responses.

awareness_of_others.label: awareness of other peoples thoughts, feelings and actions BCT
awareness_of_others.definition: BCT: surface awareness of others' thoughts, feelings and actions.

add_objects_to_the_directly_experienced_.label: add objects to the directly experienced environment BCT
add_objects_to_the_directly_experienced_.definition: An <add objects to the environment BCT> that adds an object to the person’s directly experienced environment at the time the behaviour is, or would have been, performed.

add_objects_to_the_environment_bct.label: add objects to the environment BCT
add_objects_to_the_environment_bct.definition: A <restructure the physical environment BCT> that adds objects to the person's physical surroundings.

add_objects_to_the_indirectly_experience.label: add objects to the indirectly experienced environment BCT
add_objects_to_the_indirectly_experience.definition: An <add objects to the environment BCT> that adds an object to the person’s environment at a time or location other than when and where the behaviour is performed.

adopt_changed_self_identity_bct.label: adopt changed self-identity BCT
adopt_changed_self_identity_bct.definition: A <prompt focus on self-identity BCT> that promotes the adoption of a self-identity as someone who engages in the behaviour that is different from their previous behaviour.

adopt_positive_self_identity_bct.label: adopt positive self-identity BCT
adopt_positive_self_identity_bct.definition: A <prompt focus on self-identity BCT> that promotes the adoption of a positive self-identity as someone who currently engages in the behaviour.

advise_behavioural_ways_to_change_emotio.label: advise behavioural ways to change emotions BCT
advise_behavioural_ways_to_change_emotio.definition: An <advise how to change emotions BCT> that suggests the person perform a particular behaviour to change an emotion.

advise_behavioural_ways_to_increase_nega.label: advise behavioural ways to increase negative emotions BCT
advise_behavioural_ways_to_increase_nega.definition: An <advise behavioural ways to change emotions BCT> suggesting the person perform a particular behaviour to enhance negative emotions.

advise_behavioural_ways_to_increase_posi.label: advise behavioural ways to increase positive emotions BCT
advise_behavioural_ways_to_increase_posi.definition: An <advise behavioural ways to change emotions BCT> suggesting the person perform a particular behaviour to enhance positive emotions.

advise_behavioural_ways_to_reduce_negati.label: advise behavioural ways to reduce negative emotions BCT
advise_behavioural_ways_to_reduce_negati.definition: An <advise behavioural ways to change emotions BCT> suggesting the person perform a particular behaviour to decrease negative emotions.

advise_behavioural_ways_to_reduce_positi.label: advise behavioural ways to reduce positive emotions BCT
advise_behavioural_ways_to_reduce_positi.definition: An <advise behavioural ways to change emotions BCT> suggesting the person perform a particular behaviour to decrease positive emotions.

advise_cognitive_ways_to_change_emotions.label: advise cognitive ways to change emotions BCT
advise_cognitive_ways_to_change_emotions.definition: An <advise how to change emotions BCT> that suggests the person deliberately use a particular mental process.

advise_cognitive_ways_to_increase_negati.label: advise cognitive ways to increase negative emotions BCT
advise_cognitive_ways_to_increase_negati.definition: An <advise cognitive ways to change emotions BCT> suggesting the person deliberately use a particular mental process to enhance negative emotions.

advise_cognitive_ways_to_increase_positi.label: advise cognitive ways to increase positive emotions BCT
advise_cognitive_ways_to_increase_positi.definition: An <advise cognitive ways to change emotions BCT> suggesting the person deliberately use a particular mental process to enhance positive emotions.

advise_cognitive_ways_to_reduce_negative.label: advise cognitive ways to reduce negative emotions BCT
advise_cognitive_ways_to_reduce_negative.definition: An <advise cognitive ways to change emotions BCT> suggesting the person deliberately use a particular mental process to decrease negative emotions.

advise_cognitive_ways_to_reduce_positive.label: advise cognitive ways to reduce positive emotions BCT
advise_cognitive_ways_to_reduce_positive.definition: An <advise cognitive ways to change emotions BCT> suggesting the person deliberately use a particular mental process to decrease positive emotions.

advise_goal_integration_bct.label: advise goal integration BCT
advise_goal_integration_bct.definition: A <goal directed BCT> that advises the person to adopt more than one goal in a situation where the goals facilitate each other.

advise_how_to_change_emotions_bct.label: advise how to change emotions BCT
advise_how_to_change_emotions_bct.definition: A <behaviour change technique> that suggests a method to alter emotions.

advise_how_to_increase_negative_emotions.label: advise how to increase negative emotions BCT
advise_how_to_increase_negative_emotions.definition: An <advise how to change emotions BCT> suggesting a method to enhance negative emotions.

advise_how_to_increase_positive_emotions.label: advise how to increase positive emotions BCT
advise_how_to_increase_positive_emotions.definition: An <advise how to change emotions BCT> suggesting a method to enhance positive emotions.

advise_how_to_reduce_negative_emotions_b.label: advise how to reduce negative emotions BCT
advise_how_to_reduce_negative_emotions_b.definition: An <advise how to change emotions BCT> suggesting a method to decrease negative emotions.

advise_how_to_reduce_positive_emotions_b.label: advise how to reduce positive emotions BCT
advise_how_to_reduce_positive_emotions_b.definition: An <advise how to change emotions BCT> suggesting a method to decrease positive emotions.

advise_paradoxical_behaviour_bct.label: advise paradoxical behaviour BCT
advise_paradoxical_behaviour_bct.definition: An <advise specific behaviour BCT> that advises the person to engage in an unwanted behaviour in a way that is aversive.

advise_sensory_ways_to_change_emotions_b.label: advise sensory ways to change emotions BCT
advise_sensory_ways_to_change_emotions_b.definition: An <advise how to change emotions BCT> that suggests the person use a method that stimulates one or more senses.

advise_sensory_ways_to_increase_negative.label: advise sensory ways to increase negative emotions BCT
advise_sensory_ways_to_increase_negative.definition: An <advise sensory ways to change emotions BCT> suggesting the person use a method that stimulates one or more senses to enhance negative emotions.

advise_sensory_ways_to_increase_positive.label: advise sensory ways to increase positive emotions BCT
advise_sensory_ways_to_increase_positive.definition: An <advise sensory ways to change emotions BCT> suggesting the person use a method that stimulates one or more senses to enhance positive emotions.

advise_sensory_ways_to_reduce_negative_e.label: advise sensory ways to reduce negative emotions BCT
advise_sensory_ways_to_reduce_negative_e.definition: An <advise sensory ways to change emotions BCT> suggesting the person use a method that stimulates one or more senses to decrease negative emotions.

advise_sensory_ways_to_reduce_positive_e.label: advise sensory ways to reduce positive emotions BCT
advise_sensory_ways_to_reduce_positive_e.definition: An <advise sensory ways to change emotions BCT> suggesting the person use a method that stimulates one or more senses to decrease positive emotions.

advise_specific_behaviour_bct.label: advise specific behaviour BCT
advise_specific_behaviour_bct.definition: A <behaviour change technique> that advises the person to perform a behaviour in a particular way to help change the target behaviour.

advise_to_avoid_people_who_do_an_unwante.label: advise to avoid people who do an unwanted behaviour BCT
advise_to_avoid_people_who_do_an_unwante.definition: A <guide how to perform behaviour BCT> that involves suggesting the person avoid spending time with others who do a behaviour that the person wants to reduce or stop.

advise_to_keep_behaviour_goal_in_mind_bc.label: advise to keep behaviour goal in mind BCT
advise_to_keep_behaviour_goal_in_mind_bc.definition: A <goal directed BCT> that advises the person to find ways to remind themselves of their behavioural goal.

advise_to_keep_outcome_goal_in_mind_bct.label: advise to keep outcome goal in mind BCT
advise_to_keep_outcome_goal_in_mind_bct.definition: A <goal directed BCT> that advises the person to find ways to remind themselves of their goal in terms of a desired outcome of performing the behaviour.

advise_to_seek_appraisal_support_bct.label: advise to seek appraisal support BCT
advise_to_seek_appraisal_support_bct.definition: An <advise to seek support BCT> that suggests the person try to obtain support from another in terms of information that will aid the person in evaluating themself or the situation.

advise_to_seek_emotional_support_bct.label: advise to seek emotional support BCT
advise_to_seek_emotional_support_bct.definition: An <advise to seek support BCT> that suggests the person try to obtain support from another in terms of expressing concern, caring and empathy.

advise_to_seek_informational_support_bct.label: advise to seek informational support BCT
advise_to_seek_informational_support_bct.definition: An <advise to seek support BCT> that suggests the person try to obtain support from another in terms of advice, suggestions and information.

advise_to_seek_instrumental_support_bct.label: advise to seek instrumental support BCT
advise_to_seek_instrumental_support_bct.definition: An <advise to seek support BCT> that suggests the person try to obtain support from another in terms of tangible aid.

advise_to_seek_support_bct.label: advise to seek support BCT
advise_to_seek_support_bct.definition: A <social support BCT> that involves advising the person to seek support from another person.

affirm_commitment_bct.label: affirm commitment BCT
affirm_commitment_bct.definition: A <goal directed BCT> that asks the person to affirm or reaffirm statements indicating commitment to change the behaviour.

affirm_valued_self_identity_bct.label: affirm valued self-identity BCT
affirm_valued_self_identity_bct.definition: A <prompt focus on self-identity BCT> that advises engagement in activities that affirm the person's valued attributes.

agree_behaviour_goal_bct.label: agree behaviour goal BCT
agree_behaviour_goal_bct.definition: A <goal setting BCT> that involves the intervention source agreeing with the person on a behavioural goal.

agree_on_how_to_perform_behaviour_bct.label: agree on how to perform behaviour BCT
agree_on_how_to_perform_behaviour_bct.definition: A <guide how to perform behaviour BCT> that involves reaching consensus on how to perform the behaviour.

agree_outcome_goal_bct.label: agree outcome goal BCT
agree_outcome_goal_bct.definition: A <goal setting BCT> that involves the intervention source agreeing with the person on a goal which is a positive outcome of performing the behaviour.

alter_external_stimulus_bct.label: alter external stimulus BCT
alter_external_stimulus_bct.definition: An <associative learning BCT> that involves creating, strengthening or reducing an association between the behaviour and an environmental trigger.

arrange_appraisal_support_bct.label: arrange appraisal support BCT
arrange_appraisal_support_bct.definition: An <arrange support BCT> that organises support from another in terms of information that will aid the person in evaluating themself or the situation.

arrange_emotional_support_bct.label: arrange emotional support BCT
arrange_emotional_support_bct.definition: An <arrange support BCT> that organises support from another in terms of expressing concern, caring and empathy.

arrange_informational_support_bct.label: arrange informational support BCT
arrange_informational_support_bct.definition: An <arrange support BCT> that organises support from another in terms of advice, suggestions and information.

arrange_instrumental_support_bct.label: arrange instrumental support BCT
arrange_instrumental_support_bct.definition: An <arrange support BCT> that organises support from another in terms of tangible aid.

arrange_satiation_bct.label: arrange satiation BCT
arrange_satiation_bct.definition: An <expose to stimulus BCT> that provides sustained exposure to a stimulus to reduce or extinguish an unwanted behaviour.

arrange_support_bct.label: arrange support BCT
arrange_support_bct.definition: A <social support BCT> that organises support from another for the person.

associative_learning_bct.label: associative learning BCT
associative_learning_bct.definition: A <behaviour change technique> that involves repeated pairing of a stimulus with another stimulus or with a behavioural outcome.

associative_learning_to_elicit_behaviour.label: associative learning to elicit behaviour BCT
associative_learning_to_elicit_behaviour.definition: An <associative learning BCT> that involves repeated pairing of a neutral stimulus with a stimulus that already elicits the behaviour until the neutral stimulus elicits the behaviour.

associative_learning_to_extinguish_behav.label: associative learning to extinguish behaviour BCT
associative_learning_to_extinguish_behav.definition: An <associative learning BCT> that stops the presentation of a reward for the behaviour.

attend_to_discrepancy_between_current_be.label: attend to discrepancy between current behaviour and goal BCT
attend_to_discrepancy_between_current_be.definition: A <goal directed BCT> that draws attention to discrepancies between a person's current behaviour and the person's outcome goal, behavioural goal or action plan.

behavioural_consequence_bct.label: behavioural consequence BCT
behavioural_consequence_bct.definition: A <behaviour change technique> that alters the consequences or promised consequences for the behaviour.

change_behaviour_goal_bct.label: change behaviour goal BCT
change_behaviour_goal_bct.definition: A <goal directed BCT> that changes an existing goal for the behaviour to be achieved.

change_outcome_goal_bct.label: change outcome goal BCT
change_outcome_goal_bct.definition: A <goal directed BCT> that changes an existing goal for the outcome to be achieved.

change_the_body_bct.label: change the body BCT
change_the_body_bct.definition: A <behaviour change technique> that alters the structure or functioning of the person's body.

conduct_a_behavioural_experiment_bct.label: conduct a behavioural experiment BCT
conduct_a_behavioural_experiment_bct.definition: A <behaviour change technique> that advises on how to identify and test hypotheses about the behaviour, its causes and consequences.

conserve_mental_resources_bct.label: conserve mental resources BCT
conserve_mental_resources_bct.definition: A <manage mental processes BCT> that advises a way to minimise demands on mental resources.

consider_pros_and_cons_bct.label: consider pros and cons BCT
consider_pros_and_cons_bct.definition: An <increase awareness of consequences BCT> that advises identification and comparison of the positive and negative consequences of performing or not performing the behaviour.

context_specific_non_enactment_of_behavi.label: context-specific non-enactment of behaviour BCT
context_specific_non_enactment_of_behavi.definition: An <advise specific behaviour BCT> that advises the person to refrain from engaging in the behaviour in a specified context.

context_specific_repetition_of_alternati.label: context-specific repetition of alternative behaviour BCT
context_specific_repetition_of_alternati.definition: An <advise specific behaviour BCT> that advises the person to repeat an alternative behaviour consistently in a context that previously elicited an unwanted behaviour.

context_specific_repetition_of_behaviour.label: context-specific repetition of behaviour BCT
context_specific_repetition_of_behaviour.definition: An <advise specific behaviour BCT> that advises the person to repeat the behaviour in the same context.

create_behavioural_contract_bct.label: create behavioural contract BCT
create_behavioural_contract_bct.definition: A <goal directed BCT> that creates a written specification of the behaviour to be performed, agreed on by the person, and witnessed by another person.

cue_bct.label: cue BCT
cue_bct.definition: An <alter external stimulus BCT> that introduces external information that is already associated with the behaviour in order to elicit that behaviour.

cue_signalling_reward_bct.label: cue signalling reward BCT
cue_signalling_reward_bct.definition: An <alter external stimulus BCT> that identifies an external stimulus that reliably signals that reward will follow the behaviour.

deliver_appraisal_support_bct.label: deliver appraisal support BCT
deliver_appraisal_support_bct.definition: A <deliver support BCT> that provides information that will aid the person in evaluating themself or the situation.

deliver_emotional_support_bct.label: deliver emotional support BCT
deliver_emotional_support_bct.definition: A <deliver support BCT> that provides expressions of concern, caring and empathy.

deliver_informational_support_bct.label: deliver informational support BCT
deliver_informational_support_bct.definition: A <deliver support BCT> that provides advice, suggestions and information.

deliver_instrumental_support_bct.label: deliver instrumental support BCT
deliver_instrumental_support_bct.definition: A <deliver support BCT> that provides tangible aid.

deliver_support_bct.label: deliver support BCT
deliver_support_bct.definition: A <social support BCT> that directly provides support to the person.

demonstrate_the_behaviour_bct.label: demonstrate the behaviour BCT
demonstrate_the_behaviour_bct.definition: A <guide how to perform behaviour BCT> that provides an observable sample of the performance of the behaviour for the person to aspire to or imitate.

directly_restructure_the_physical_enviro.label: directly restructure the physical environment BCT
directly_restructure_the_physical_enviro.definition: A <restructure the physical environment BCT> that changes the person’s directly experienced environment at the time the behaviour is, or would have been, performed.

directly_restructure_the_social_environm.label: directly restructure the social environment BCT
directly_restructure_the_social_environm.definition: A <restructure the social environment BCT> that changes the person's directly experienced environment at the time the behaviour is, or would have been, performed.

draw_attention_to_incompatible_beliefs_b.label: draw attention to incompatible beliefs BCT
draw_attention_to_incompatible_beliefs_b.definition: A <suggest different perspective on behaviour BCT> that draws the person's attention to the discrepancies between current or past behaviour and self-identity.

encourage_pharmacological_support_bct.label: encourage pharmacological support BCT
encourage_pharmacological_support_bct.definition: A <promote pharmacological support BCT> that encourages the person to use medicines or other drugs.

expose_to_stimulus_bct.label: expose to stimulus BCT
expose_to_stimulus_bct.definition: An <alter external stimulus BCT> that sustains the person's exposure to a stimulus associated with the behaviour.

expose_to_sustained_aversive_stimulus_bc.label: expose to sustained aversive stimulus BCT
expose_to_sustained_aversive_stimulus_bc.definition: An <expose to stimulus BCT> that involves sustained exposure to an aversive stimulus to reduce the likelihood of the behaviour when encountering that stimulus.

facilitate_alternative_goal_directed_act.label: facilitate alternative goal-directed activity BCT
facilitate_alternative_goal_directed_act.definition: A <goal directed BCT> that enables the person to engage in an alternative rewarding behaviour that increases the likelihood of goal achievement.

generalise_behaviour_bct.label: generalise behaviour BCT
generalise_behaviour_bct.definition: An <advise specific behaviour BCT> that advises the person to perform the behaviour which is already performed in a particular context, in a similar context.

goal_directed_bct.label: goal directed BCT
goal_directed_bct.definition: A <behaviour change technique> that sets or changes goals.

goal_setting_bct.label: goal setting BCT
goal_setting_bct.definition: A <goal directed BCT> that sets goals.

goal_strategising_bct.label: goal strategising BCT
goal_strategising_bct.definition: A <goal directed BCT> in which the person analyses factors influencing the behaviour and generates, selects, or reviews strategies to increase facilitators and overcome barriers.

gradually_increase_exposure_to_aversive_.label: gradually increase exposure to aversive stimulus BCT
gradually_increase_exposure_to_aversive_.definition: An <expose to stimulus BCT> that involves gradually increasing exposure to an aversive stimulus to reduce the likelihood of the behaviour when encountering that stimulus.

guide_how_to_perform_behaviour_bct.label: guide how to perform behaviour BCT
guide_how_to_perform_behaviour_bct.definition: A <behaviour change technique> that provides guidance regarding how to perform the behaviour.

identify_self_as_role_model_bct.label: identify self as role model BCT
identify_self_as_role_model_bct.definition: A <prompt focus on self-identity BCT> that informs the person that their behaviour may be an example to others.

imagine_punishment_bct.label: imagine punishment BCT
imagine_punishment_bct.definition: An <increase awareness of consequences BCT> that guides the person to imagine performing the unwanted behaviour in a real-life situation followed by experiencing an unpleasant consequence for performing that behaviour.

imagine_reward_bct.label: imagine reward BCT
imagine_reward_bct.definition: An <increase awareness of consequences BCT> that guides the person to imagine performing the wanted behaviour in a real-life situation followed by experiencing a pleasant consequence for performing that behaviour.

implore_to_change_behaviour_bct.label: implore to change behaviour BCT
implore_to_change_behaviour_bct.definition: An <awareness of other people's thoughts, feelings and actions BCT> that makes an emotional or earnest appeal to change the person's behaviour.

increase_awareness_of_behaviour_bct.label: increase awareness of behaviour BCT
increase_awareness_of_behaviour_bct.definition: A <behaviour change technique> that draws attention to the behaviour.

increase_awareness_of_consequences_bct.label: increase awareness of consequences BCT
increase_awareness_of_consequences_bct.definition: A <behaviour change technique> that draws attention to consequences of the behaviour in the normal course of events.

increase_awareness_of_option_of_novel_be.label: increase awareness of option of novel behaviour BCT
increase_awareness_of_option_of_novel_be.definition: An <increase awareness of behaviour BCT> that draws attention to the possibility of performing a novel behaviour.

increase_awareness_of_others_approval_bc.label: increase awareness of others approval BCT
increase_awareness_of_others_approval_bc.definition: An <awareness of other people's thoughts, feelings and actions BCT> that increases awareness of whether others will like, approve, dislike, or disapprove of the behaviour.

increase_salience_of_behaviour_bct.label: increase salience of behaviour BCT
increase_salience_of_behaviour_bct.definition: An <increase awareness of behaviour BCT> that makes the possibility of performing the behaviour more distinctive or prominent.

increase_salience_of_consequences_bct.label: increase salience of consequences BCT
increase_salience_of_consequences_bct.definition: An <awareness of consequences BCT> that changes behaviour by the source emphasising the consequences of performing a behaviour to the person in a way that makes them memorable.

indirectly_restructure_the_physical_envi.label: indirectly restructure the physical environment BCT
indirectly_restructure_the_physical_envi.definition: A <restructure the physical environment BCT> that changes the person's environment at a time or location other than when and where the behaviour is performed.

indirectly_restructure_the_social_enviro.label: indirectly restructure the social environment BCT
indirectly_restructure_the_social_enviro.definition: A <restructure the social environment BCT> that changes the person's environment at a time or location other than when and where the behaviour is performed.

induce_anticipated_regret_bct.label: induce anticipated regret BCT
induce_anticipated_regret_bct.definition: An <inform about emotional consequences BCT> that focuses on expectations of remorse after performing or not performing the behaviour.

inform_about_antecedents_bct.label: inform about antecedents BCT
inform_about_antecedents_bct.definition: A <suggest different perspective on behaviour BCT> that involves providing factual information to the person regarding triggers or influences that precede the initiation of the behaviour.

inform_about_emotional_consequences_bct.label: inform about emotional consequences BCT
inform_about_emotional_consequences_bct.definition: An <increase awareness of consequences BCT> that provides information about the emotional consequences of performing or not performing the behaviour.

inform_about_environmental_consequences_.label: inform about environmental consequences BCT
inform_about_environmental_consequences_.definition: An <increase awareness of consequences BCT> that provides information about the environmental consequences of performing or not performing the behaviour.

inform_about_health_consequences_bct.label: inform about health consequences BCT
inform_about_health_consequences_bct.definition: An <increase awareness of consequences BCT> that provides information about the physical or mental health consequences of performing or not performing the behaviour.

inform_about_negative_emotional_conseque.label: inform about negative emotional consequences BCT
inform_about_negative_emotional_conseque.definition: An <inform about emotional consequences BCT> that provides information about the negative emotional consequences of performing or not performing the behaviour.

inform_about_negative_environmental_cons.label: inform about negative environmental consequences BCT
inform_about_negative_environmental_cons.definition: An <inform about environmental consequences BCT> that provides information about the negative environmental consequences of performing or not performing the behaviour.

inform_about_negative_health_consequence.label: inform about negative health consequences BCT
inform_about_negative_health_consequence.definition: An <inform about health consequences BCT> that provides information about the negative physical or mental health consequences of performing or not performing the behaviour.

inform_about_negative_social_consequence.label: inform about negative social consequences BCT
inform_about_negative_social_consequence.definition: An <inform about social consequences BCT> that provides information about the negative social consequences of performing or not performing the behaviour.

inform_about_positive_emotional_conseque.label: inform about positive emotional consequences BCT
inform_about_positive_emotional_conseque.definition: An <inform about emotional consequences BCT> that provides information about the positive emotional consequences of performing or not performing the behaviour.

inform_about_positive_environmental_cons.label: inform about positive environmental consequences BCT
inform_about_positive_environmental_cons.definition: An <inform about environmental consequences BCT> that provides information about the positive environmental consequences of performing or not performing the behaviour.

inform_about_positive_health_consequence.label: inform about positive health consequences BCT
inform_about_positive_health_consequence.definition: An <inform about health consequences BCT> that provides information about the positive physical or mental health consequences of performing or not performing the behaviour.

inform_about_positive_social_consequence.label: inform about positive social consequences BCT
inform_about_positive_social_consequence.definition: An <inform about social consequences BCT> that provides information about the positive social consequences of performing or not performing the behaviour.

inform_about_social_consequences_bct.label: inform about social consequences BCT
inform_about_social_consequences_bct.definition: An <increase awareness of consequences BCT> that provides information about the social consequences of performing or not performing the behaviour.

instruct_how_to_perform_a_behaviour_bct.label: instruct how to perform a behaviour BCT
instruct_how_to_perform_a_behaviour_bct.definition: A <guide how to perform behaviour BCT> that involves telling the person how to perform the behaviour.

make_a_goal_public_bct.label: make a goal public BCT
make_a_goal_public_bct.definition: A <goal directed BCT> that involves the person communicating their intention to achieve a goal.

manage_mental_processes_bct.label: manage mental processes BCT
manage_mental_processes_bct.definition: A <behaviour change technique> that advises how to manage mental processes to facilitate the behaviour.

monitor_emotional_consequences_bct.label: monitor emotional consequences BCT
monitor_emotional_consequences_bct.definition: A <monitoring BCT> that involves the person assessing their emotions after performing the behaviour.

monitoring_bct.label: monitoring BCT
monitoring_bct.definition: A <behaviour change technique> that involves gathering or using information about performance.

observe_behaviour_without_feedback_bct.label: observe behaviour without feedback BCT
observe_behaviour_without_feedback_bct.definition: A <monitoring BCT> that observes current performance of the behaviour with the person’s knowledge but without providing feedback about their behaviour.

observe_outcome_of_behaviour_without_fee.label: observe outcome of behaviour without feedback BCT
observe_outcome_of_behaviour_without_fee.definition: A <monitoring BCT> that observes an outcome of performing the behaviour with the person’s knowledge but without providing feedback about the outcome.

outcome_consequence_bct.label: outcome consequence BCT
outcome_consequence_bct.definition: A <behaviour change technique> that alters the consequences or promised consequences for an outcome that results from performing or not performing the behaviour.

overcorrect_unwanted_behaviour_bct.label: overcorrect unwanted behaviour BCT
overcorrect_unwanted_behaviour_bct.definition: An <advise specific behaviour BCT> that advises the person to repeat a wanted behaviour in an exaggerated way following performance of an unwanted behaviour.

persuade_about_personal_capability_bct.label: persuade about personal capability BCT
persuade_about_personal_capability_bct.definition: A <prompt thinking related to successful performance BCT> that persuades the person that they can successfully perform the behaviour.

plan_inclusion_of_enjoyment_bct.label: plan inclusion of enjoyment BCT
plan_inclusion_of_enjoyment_bct.definition: A <goal directed BCT> that advises the person to plan a way of performing the behaviour that is pleasurable or satisfying.

practise_behaviour_bct.label: practise behaviour BCT
practise_behaviour_bct.definition: An <advise specific behaviour BCT> that advises repetition of the behaviour in a way that has the function of increasing the skill in performing the behaviour.

present_information_from_credible_influe.label: present information from credible influence BCT
present_information_from_credible_influe.definition: An <awareness of other people's thoughts, feelings and actions BCT> that presents information from a credible person or organisation to influence the behaviour.

promise_aversive_consequence_for_situati.definition: A <promise aversive consequence for behaviour BCT> that promises the consequence will be provided for the behaviour in one situation but not in another.

promise_positive_consequence_for_alterna.definition: A <promise positive consequence for behaviour BCT> that promises the consequence will be provided for the behaviour that is different from the unwanted behaviour.

promise_positive_consequence_for_approxi.label: promise positive consequence for approximating behaviour BCT
promise_positive_consequence_for_approxi.definition: A <promise positive consequence for behaviour BCT> where the consequence is provided as the performance gradually gets closer to the behaviour.

promise_positive_consequence_for_behavio.label: promise positive consequence for behaviour BCT
promise_positive_consequence_for_behavio.definition: A <promise consequence for behaviour BCT> where the consequence is positive.
